versions.name: RXV2-0.9.853-cells-never-impossible
versions.notes: Battery: one cell-count rule everywhere — a told count only while physically possible, else the even-count guess (no more 7.5 V per cell on 12S); a guessed count shows '· 12S?'; the klaxon reads FC telemetry too and stays quiet while armed; the battery guardian no longer stops at 6 cells

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.852-battery-one-line
versions.notes: Battery card is one line: 'Average 3.8 V per cell' — the colour says the rest

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.851-battery-card-honest
versions.notes: Battery card: volts per cell is the truth — the flight controller's percent (capacity used since power-on, not charge state) no longer shows; mAh reads 'used since power-on'

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.850-battery-first
versions.notes: Home page: a battery card under the model name from the first moment — volts per cell, cells, total, and the flight controller's percent, mAh and amps when it has them; green / amber / red

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.849-tracking-time-explained
versions.notes: Governor page: tracking time explained — it is the time for a full-range head-speed change (0 to full), so a bank step takes a fraction of it; want a 2-second bank change, set about 20

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.848-new-app-icon
versions.notes: New app icon on iPhone, iPad and Android: a red helicopter with LDRC on the cabin, over our sky and hill.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.847-rates-chart-shows-every-curve
versions.notes: Rates chart: a curve that lies exactly on another is now drawn dashed, so the one beneath shows through. Yaw with Centre equal to Max Rate was hidden under a straight collective line, and identical roll and pitch hid roll. The collective legend now says degrees, not degrees per second.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.846-pages-open-in-a-browser
versions.notes: Pages opened in a web browser over WiFi work again. Compressed files were sent labelled 'compressed' twice, which a browser reads as compressed twice and then shows nothing; since 0.9.844 that was every page. The phone apps carry their own pages and were never affected.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.845-save-button-label-stuck
versions.notes: The Save button on the Rates, PIDs, PID+, Governor and Travel extents pages could be left saying 'Verifying...' for good after a save, whenever the read-back took more than a second. The two flashes captured each other's text; now one timer always puts the real label back.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.844-page-follows-the-bank-switch
versions.notes: With the transmitter on, the Rates and PIDs pages follow its bank switch: the receiver refreshes the flight controller's bank every two seconds while a phone is watching and the model is disarmed, and the page moves to that bank. Never while you have unsaved edits or your cursor is in a field: then a one-line note says which bank the transmitter is on and your edits stay put until you save or discard them.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.843-max-vel-read-only
versions.notes: Rates page: Max Vel is shown as a plain number again, no box and no keyboard. It only repeats the full-stick speed the type delivers.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.842-transmitter-off-first
versions.notes: The update page now checks the transmitter before anything starts and says 'Turn the transmitter off first' if it is on. A refusal from the receiver over WiFi is shown at once instead of being discovered as 'did not complete' minutes later.

rotorflight.line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
